Preserve payload, due_at and unrelated/future/completed jobs. All writes must be transactional. Concurrent SQLite BUSY is allowed only with a bounded harness retry, never two successful owners. Methods use this.database.prepare(...).get/all/run and this.database.transaction(fn)(); no network/files/imports. Local completion is a database transition only, no external side effect.
